bundles.name: card-editor-robustness
bundles.intent: Harden the Unit/Building Card editor panels (UnitCardPanel.Edit.cs / BuildingCardPanel.Edit.cs). Clear the undo `_history` when a raw-JSON Save wholesale-replaces the bound definition (DW-64) and when LoadFactionFromPath swaps in a new faction (DW-65), so stale closures can't dangle. Call ReleaseFocus() before firing Undo/Redo (DW-69), and commit required-num SpinBox fields only on a real ValueChanged rather than on blur-at-displayed-0 (DW-71). Make CloneUnit copy the Story-3.16 shop fields (SellsItems/ShopStock/ShopRadius) (DW-72), and rebuild/re-read the Ultimate picker when the Simple/Advanced segment switches so the hidden pane can't show a stale selection (DW-133).

bundles.name: techtree-authoring-sync
bundles.intent: Fix the TechTreePanel graph-authoring surface. Add Ctrl+Z/Y undo for edge add/remove (DW-75), matching the card editors. Add a cross-namespace uniqueness check so a research id cannot collide with a building id before both become same-name GraphNodes (Godot AddChild auto-renames the second, breaking by-name edge/selection resolution) and resolve OnNodeSelected via the last-wins researchById lookup (DW-89). Have structural research edits in ResearchCardPanel (Create/Delete/Duplicate) notify TechTreePanel.RebuildGraph so the graph and inspector don't drift until the next R toggle (DW-92).

bundles.name: research-command-card
bundles.intent: Fix the in-match research command-card in CommandCardSystem. Add mutual exclusivity between the Research button grid and the Shop/Revive/Train grids so a building authored with both doesn't draw overlapping grids at the same coordinates (DW-90). Render the faction-wide in-progress research status and Cancel affordance independent of the selected building's own producer/offer status, so a producer building can show its research and a non-offering building can still cancel an in-progress order (DW-91). Extract the research-button dim predicate and upgrade-summary formatting into Godot-free Core/Economy helpers and unit-test them (DW-93).

bundles.name: creation-suite-panel-infra
bundles.intent: Consolidate shared CreationSuite/overlay panel infrastructure in one pass. Single-source the copy-pasted EnsureKitInitialized bootstrap and Heading/Body label helpers (now duplicated across ~15 panels/overlays) into a shared base type or static helper (DW-23). Add an _ExitTree override to every panel that subscribes to GameState.ModeChanged so the handler is unsubscribed if the panel is freed (DW-74). Replace the ad-hoc hardcoded CanvasLayer.Layer values (9/11/13/14…) with a shared layer-constants registry so z-order collisions among panels are impossible by construction (DW-76).

bundles.name: hero-revive-shop-affordances
bundles.intent: Fix HUD affordance gaps in the CommandCardSystem hero/shop grids (needs /godot-verify). Render revive buttons for a building that BOTH produces units and is flagged revives_heroes, not only in the !canProduce branch (DW-31). Add a SourceDef!=null filter to RefreshReviveButtons so a hero minted without a SourceDef doesn't render a dead, priced revive button (DW-33). Make shop Buy target the nearest in-range hero WITH a free inventory slot instead of the single nearest hero, so an affordable Buy no longer silently no-ops when the closest hero is full (DW-49). Render ItemDefinition.Icon textures (Button.Icon) across the inventory grid, shop Buy buttons, and picker cards instead of name+text only (DW-50).

bundles.name: item-modifier-hardening
bundles.intent: Harden the item / ModifierStore stack. When ModifierStore.Apply refuses an install because an entity's 8-slot ring is full, emit a diagnostic/denial cue instead of silently dropping (DW-83), and have ItemSystem check that return value so a full-slot hero doesn't claim a silently-inert stat item (DW-34). Box the new item ref in EntityPlacer.PlaceItem's redo closure so place->undo->redo->undo can't leak the redone ground item (DW-35). Either add the stat-item-XOR-consumable validator rule or soften the docs to permit hybrids, with test coverage (DW-38). Add an away-from-hero pickup-traversal test exercising the MoveTarget steering branch (DW-39). Add a per-stat move_speed cap in ItemDefinitionValidator (the uniform ±1000 cap tunnels/freezes a hero) plus a top clamp in ModifierSystem.RecomputeEntity for the shared effective-stat-overflow class (DW-42, DW-28). Add filename-safe charset validation to the item Id (Persist does Path.Combine + File writes, so `../../foo` escapes the items dir) (DW-47).

bundles.name: projectile-ttl-clamp
bundles.intent: Add a snap-to-goal clamp and a max-lifetime/TTL to ProjectileSystem.Tick. A high authored projectile_speed (up to the validator's 32768 ceiling) overshoots the 0.5-unit hit radius every tick and never converges, so the shell orbits its target forever and permanently leaks its MAX_PROJECTILES slot until the pool fills and the unit stops firing. This is a determinism-relevant sim change and will require re-recording the affected goldens.

bundles.name: scenario-applier-canonical-order
bundles.intent: Make ScenarioApplier place items (and units/buildings) in the same canonical order that StartStateHash folds them (sorted by id/X/Z) rather than raw array order. Today two scenarios with the same item set in different array order hash identically yet assign different runtime packed refs, so a PickupItem/inventory ref could resolve to a different physical item per peer. This is a determinism fix and will require a golden re-baseline. The direction was already decided (canonicalize placement order, 2026-07-19).

bundles.name: gathering-system-behavior
bundles.intent: Complete the Story-4.7 gathering behavior. Wire EntityPlacer.PlaceResourceNode (and its authoring UI) to the full node fields (collection_model/resource_type/requires_structure/owner_slot/income_period_ticks) instead of the legacy 4-arg Create that hard-defaults every editor-placed node to GATHER/Ore/no-gate/Neutral (DW-77). Add a spatial index (or cache) for the requires_structure gate check so FindBestNode is not O(nodes x buildings) per idle worker per tick (DW-79). Free a Streaming worker whose gate closes permanently back to Idle to re-seek a different eligible node instead of parking it in Gathering forever producing zero credit (DW-80, decided 2026-07-20).

bundles.name: gather-state-checksum-fold
bundles.intent: Fold the per-worker in-flight gather state (EntityWorld.GatherState/CarryAmount/GatherTarget) into SimChecksum. These arrays mutate mid-match yet are currently unfolded, so a worker's carried load or gather-cycle state can diverge between clients undetected. Per the checksum-fold-timing rule this qualifies for a fold; the change re-baselines the goldens and must pass the two-run byte-identical test.

bundles.name: faction-definition-validator-hardening
bundles.intent: Harden the faction/definition validators in Core/Definitions. Distinguish an omitted building `hp` from an intentional 100 (JSON-presence tracking or a buildings-only nullable Hp) so a forgotten hp becomes a located import error (DW-55). Wrap FactionDefinition.LoadFromFile's JsonSerializer.Deserialize in try/catch so a malformed value yields a located aggregated error rather than a raw JsonException (DW-62). Add null-element/null-list guards to TechTreeValidator (DW-100), ResourceCostValidator (DW-101), and FactionDefinition.GetUnit/IndexOfUnit/GetUnitByCategory/GetUnitsByCategory (DW-103) so a null entry no longer NREs at load. Add a duplicate-id check for Buildings and Research to FactionValidator, mirroring the existing Units check (DW-111). Convert TechTreeValidator.Visit's recursive DFS to an explicit-stack walk to remove the deep-chain stack-overflow risk (DW-59).

bundles.name: mesh-path-integrity
bundles.intent: Close the mesh_path integrity gap. Repoint the aviary mesh_path in alpha_faction.json/beta_faction.json (bonded_aerie.glb / wraithwing_brood.glb) to an existing on-disk placeholder GLB until real art lands (DW-102). Add a mesh_path disk-existence check as a presentation-layer/content-authoring lint (editor Save/discovery edge) — per the 2026-07-19 decision to keep this out of the sim FactionValidator — so an authored mesh_path that resolves to no on-disk file is caught (DW-104).

bundles.name: faction-definer-wizard-hardening
bundles.intent: Harden the Faction Definer wizard (FactionDefinerWizardCore / FactionDefinerPanel). Catch IOException/UnauthorizedAccess around the File.Move and re-check File.Exists so the TOCTOU race surfaces the 'already exists' message not a generic one (DW-112). Add a discard confirmation before ResetWizard when a re-open would drop non-default draft state (DW-113, decided). Add FactionValidator >=0 checks for StartingOre/StartingCrystal (DW-115) and the matching StepForError cases for starting_ore/starting_crystal (DW-114) and raw_json (DW-116). Have OnFinishPressed honor ClearStaleHeroReference's return and show a 'hero selection was cleared' note before proceeding (DW-118, decided). DistinctBy(Id) the hero-candidate list so two same-id roster units don't render as duplicate Hero buttons (DW-119).

bundles.name: onboarding-panel-hardening
bundles.intent: Harden OnboardingPanel. Assign a non-colliding CanvasLayer.Layer (currently 14, colliding with AbilityEditorPanel) (DW-129). Add _UnhandledInput Escape dismissal that closes only when onboarding is topmost and Settings is closed, calling SetInputAsHandled — per the recorded precedence decision (DW-130). Remember the unit id StartFromTemplate created in step 1 and re-bind/verify it on steps 2/3 so tune-stats and promote-hero apply to that unit rather than whatever is currently bound (DW-131).

bundles.name: custom-building-runtime
bundles.intent: Make placed Custom buildings first-class at runtime. Extract one BuildingStore.CreateFromDefinition(def,pos,faction,id) and call it from both sim (PlaceBuildingDirectById) and editor (CreateEditorBuilding) placement, ending the hand-copied stat-threading class (DW-172), which then lets group-move undo restore the full def-derived stat set (Health/MaxHealth/SupplyBonus/shop/revive) by re-resolving from DefinitionId (DW-173). Resolve BuildingType.Custom as a prerequisite SOURCE by threading the authored DefinitionId instead of TechTreeChecker.BuildingTypeId(Custom)=='' (DW-57). Widen CommandCardSystem canProduce and make GetProductionUnits def-aware so a Custom producer shows its train buttons (DW-168). Derive building footprint from the BuildingDefinition (authored field or mesh AABB) rather than the fixed 5x3x5 CUSTOM_FOOTPRINT (DW-169). Re-discover/append a BuildingBridge render bucket on an unknown DefinitionId so a mid-session-authored or third-faction custom building isn't invisible (DW-171).

bundles.name: custom-building-triggers
bundles.intent: Extend trigger building_type resolution to accept authored building-def ids so Custom buildings can be referenced in triggers. The ScenarioValidator/ScenarioDirector building_type checks are still Enum.TryParse<BuildingType> enum-only, mirroring the scenario-buildings gate. The Epic-7 trigger-DSL dependency this was blocked on has now landed (stories 7-1..7-15 done), so this is buildable.

bundles.name: terrain-stroke-undo
bundles.intent: Fix the TerrainBrush stroke-undo state machine. Track was-absent regions in SnapshotRegions/RestoreRegions so a stroke that auto-creates a new Terrain3D region can be undone (remove_region on undo) (DW-141). Ensure EndPaint runs when T is pressed mid-drag so _isPainting and the pending stroke snapshot aren't stranded (DW-142). Add a cheap before-vs-after equality check so a no-op stroke doesn't push an undo command that silently absorbs a later Ctrl+Z (DW-143). Block Ctrl+Z while a stroke is in progress (consult TerrainBrush._isPainting in EntityPlacer's undo handler) so undo can't race the live operate() and corrupt the entry (DW-144).

bundles.name: editor-state-f5-persistence
bundles.intent: Fix editor state that doesn't survive the F5 Edit->Play->Edit round-trip. Mirror editor-placed map items into ScenarioData.Items (add an item ScenarioSyncOp handler paralleling the building/unit protocol) so placed items aren't lost on save/reload/F5 (DW-137). Add an invalidate/Clear method to EditorHistory and call it in MainScene.ResetToAuthoredStart so a post-F5 undo can no longer corrupt ScenarioData against a stale history (DW-138).

bundles.name: pathability-determinism
bundles.intent: Close pathability/movement correctness gaps in Navigation. Add a swept (DDA) blocked-cell check between pos and np in MovementSystem so a fast unit can't tunnel a 1-cell wall in one tick (DW-147). Validate spawns against the resolved union grid at load time and confine an already-in-blocked unit rather than letting it traverse blocked cells freely (DW-148). Make PathabilityGrid.DeriveSlopeBlockedInto sample all four neighbours (or central difference) so far east/south edge cells auto-block and cliff walls don't land one cell to the low side (DW-149). Route PathabilityTool's cell mapping through the shared FlowField.WorldToCell helper so editor-painted cell == sim-blocked cell can't silently drift (DW-150).

bundles.name: map-bounds-guards
bundles.intent: Enforce map bounds consistently. Reject coordinates beyond the +/-grid extent (or enforce/document MapBounds<=128) in ScenarioValidator so blocking footprints past the +/-128 flow-grid don't alias onto edge cells and false-flag an unrelated start (DW-158). Add the +/-MapBounds guard to EntityPlacer prop place/paste/duplicate/group-move, mirroring WaterTool.CommitDrag, so an off-map paste doesn't persist then fail validation confusingly (DW-159). Wire MapBounds into CameraPhase pan-limits (and optionally NavigationPhase) so a smaller chosen size actually restricts the runtime camera/nav footprint instead of covering the full +/-128 (DW-165).

bundles.name: start-position-editor
bundles.intent: Fix start-position editor interaction/robustness (needs /godot-verify). Route the start-slot '-' remove through EditorHistory and defer the '+' count increment until a backing slot is actually placed (DW-161). Size the slot set by max declared Slot+1 and drive toggle/remove identity from PlayerSlots[i].Slot so a validator-legal non-contiguous set (e.g. {0,3}) doesn't drop markers and misroute toggles (DW-163). Push an EditorHistory entry for economy-spinner edits to an already-placed start slot so the hash-folded StartCrystal/StartOre change is undoable (DW-167).

bundles.name: editor-group-ops
bundles.intent: Fix editor group-op fidelity and coverage. Carry worker overrides, pre_built, and node collection/owner fields through EntityPlacer group move/duplicate/paste so re-derived placements aren't lossy (DW-151). Account for terrain height in FinishMarquee/GroundPointOf so box-select doesn't miss elevated entities and 3D selection markers don't sink through the ground (DW-153). Extract the EntityPlacer group-op composition Godot-free and test that one group op == one undo step against the real composition rather than only a HashSet proxy (DW-155).

bundles.name: packager-props-roundtrip-test
bundles.intent: Add a ContentPackager .chimera.zip round-trip test for props/cameras/water, exercising the package/import surface one level above the already-proven JSON round-trip. Terrain has a packager round-trip test but props/cameras/water are only covered at the JSON layer, leaving the AC's package/import path unexercised.

bundles.name: minimap-preview-gizmo-hide
bundles.intent: Prevent the minimap preview from capturing editor gizmos. MinimapPreviewRenderer renders the live edit-mode World3D with no cull mask, so start-position flags, the placement ghost, and active overlays can bleed into preview.png. Hide the editor-only layers/gizmos (via cull mask / visibility) for the one-shot render. The preview.png is consumed downstream by stories 11.1/9.7/9.10.

bundles.name: win-condition-koth-elimination
bundles.intent: Close two win-condition gaps. Make fully-wiped factions eligible for total-wipeout elimination under King of the Hill so a mutual-annihilation KotH match resolves via last-team-standing, without perturbing the hold-race path (DW-188, decided). Extract the per-player-elimination presentation decision (localFaction + WinStateStore + IsFullyResolved -> Continue/EliminateLocal/GameOver) into a pure Tier-1-testable helper and/or a scripted godot-verify scenario, so the headline elimination UX can't regress with the whole suite green (DW-190).

bundles.name: dsl-reset-checksum-sweep
bundles.intent: Generalize the reset/checksum determinism tripwires. Lift the DW-19 exhaustive-sweep technique (DivergingFields/NonDefaultValue/SyntheticallyFillArrays) out of EntityWorldClearCompletenessTests into a shared type-agnostic [Theory] over every store ClearForReset touches, so a dropped Array.Clear in ProjectileStore/HeroStore/ItemStore (whose fields are checksum-folded) can't ship green (DW-196). Bound TriggerEnabledStore.IsEnabled by Count (or wipe the tail on Reset/Clear) so re-applying a scenario with FEWER triggers doesn't leave a stale enabled tail, with a shrink-path regression test (DW-197). Extract the DW-20 fighting-reset precondition block into a helper and assert it against all three checksum hosts (not just the pre-reset host) so a fixture that goes vacuous only on the re-apply path can't trivially pass (DW-198).

bundles.name: dsl-robustness
bundles.intent: Harden the DSL load/runtime guards. Add a Tier-1 test that derives the graph-only kind set from ToFlat's actual throw/drop behavior so TriggerGraph.IsGraphOnlyKind and ToFlat can't silently drift when a future graph-only kind is added (DW-181). Convert the load-time run_trigger cycle detectors (DslLoopGate.RunCycleDfs and EventDispatchPlan.CycleDfs) to explicit-stack iterative walks, or add a global trigger-count cap, so a very long acyclic run_trigger chain can't StackOverflow at load — matching the runtime MaxRunTriggerDepth=16 seatbelt (DW-191).

bundles.name: dsl-graph-editor-fields
bundles.intent: Make T3 node-graph nodes fully authorable in DslGraphEditorPanel. Give every dedicated graph-only leaf kind (ShowObjective/CompleteObjective/FailObjective and the pre-existing OrderUnits/MoveCamera/etc.) an exec-in/out PortsOf case so a palette-added node is wireable instead of an unsaveable dead node (DW-195). Add a selected-node property inspector (reusing the card-editor field-row + validation badge) so ExprLiteral/ExprVar/RaiseEvent/ActionNode payload fields can be edited rather than carrying palette defaults only (DW-179). Both directions were decided 2026-07-19.

bundles.name: save-import-integrity
bundles.intent: Close save/import integrity gaps. In WinConditionPhase.DoImport, clear the author-local TerrainRef (else-branch) when an imported package bundles zero terrain files, so a stale TerrainRef doesn't linger (DW-145). Run ScenarioValidator.Validate on save across all editor authoring paths (MapGeneratorPanel, PersistenceManifestPanel, etc.) and surface a located error, so editor surfaces can no longer save a scenario the fail-closed loader then rejects — the author-lockout class (DW-186).

bundles.name: scenario-load-phase-hardening
bundles.intent: Harden ScenarioLoadPhase.ResolveSlotFactionDefs. Add the interim bounds guard on the per-slot write `_ctx.SlotFactionDefs[(int)faction] = def` so a scenario slot >=4 doesn't index out of range (DW-95, DW-96 — same site, both decided as the cheap missing-guard add). Wrap the FactionDefinition.LoadFromFile(abs) call in try/catch so a hand-corrupted scenario-assigned faction file that fails the lenient Validate logs and skips that slot instead of throwing uncaught and crashing the whole scene load (DW-123).

bundles.name: editor-panel-scenario-rebind
bundles.intent: Wire the CreationSuite editor panels' SetScenario into the runtime scenario reload/import path so a panel rebinds its held ScenarioData after a reload. Today PersistenceManifestPanel/TriggerEditorPanel (and siblings) capture _scenario once at Initialize with zero callers of their SetScenario, so after a reload a panel edits a stale object and can save it back to the originally-captured path (silent data loss / wrong-target save). The panels and the reload path both exist today; this is wiring, not new infrastructure.

bundles.name: hero-store-delete-lifecycle
bundles.intent: Free the HeroStore row when a hero-linked unit is deleted in the editor. EntityWorld.Destroy does not free the row nor clear the store's back-reference EntityId, so the row leaks and its EntityId dangles at a dead/recycled entity. The prior 'restore as plain unit' concern (DW-51) is already resolved, so freeing the row on delete is a mechanical lifecycle fix.

bundles.name: ai-supply-gating-guard
bundles.intent: Guard AiOpponentSystem's supply-headroom scoring against a scenario with supply.enabled:false. SupplyHeadroom = SupplyCap - SupplyUsed can saturate to a meaningless deeply-negative magnitude when SupplyUsed climbs unboundedly past SupplyCap (never blocked, since gating is disabled), skewing the expand-supply ladder. Skip the supply-headroom branch when supply gating is disabled. (Low priority; AiOpponentSystem is also float-based and slated for a separate float->Fixed determinism pass.)

bundles.name: signature-mechanic-test-hardening
bundles.intent: Harden SignatureMechanicRealContentTests. Assert AbilityRegistry.LoadFromDirectory's Count (or pass a failing onSkipped) so a silently-skipped invalid ability file is caught (DW-107). Derive the pre-damage amount from def.Hp (or assert def.Hp>30) instead of a fixed Fixed.FromInt(30), so the test isn't fragile against future low-HP roster content (DW-108). Hoist the real content into a shared static fixture so the two-run determinism test doesn't re-read from disk twice per run (DW-109). Issue the cast intents via GoldenChecksumReplay.RunAndRecord's perturb hook rather than inside the build callback (DW-110).

bundles.name: research-parity-test-coverage
bundles.intent: Add the missing research/definition parity test coverage. Add a BuildingDefinition.Prerequisites round-trip test alongside the existing AvailableResearch cases in FactionWriteRoundTripTests so the 'round-trips exactly like Prerequisites' claim is pinned by a shared assertion (DW-82). Add a MatchLifecycleController seam test asserting Lockstep/ReplayPlayer's Buildings/Items/Research references are the same instances as Host, so a dropped wiring line can't silently break online/replay parity (DW-84). Add a StartResearch/CancelResearch replay-vs-live round-trip to CommandApplyParityTests, matching the BuyItem/UseItem/SetRally cases, so a dropped Research forwarding arg is caught (DW-86).

bundles.name: ai-test-constant-drift-guard
bundles.intent: Remove the silent-drift risk in AsymmetryPlaytestValidationTests, whose harness constants (InitialWaveSize=5, base positions (45,0,0)/(-45,0,0)) hand-copy AiOpponentSystem's internal attack-threshold and P1_BASE values. Expose those constants as internal (InternalsVisibleTo) and reference them symbolically, or add a drift-guard assertion, so retuning AiOpponentSystem doesn't leave the test silently stale.

bundles.name: settings-serialization-single-source
bundles.intent: Extract a single Godot-free SettingsSerialization.Options (WriteIndented/CommentHandling.Skip/AllowTrailingCommas) in src/Core/Definitions and reference it from both SettingsManager and SettingsDataRoundTripTests. The test currently hand-replicates the JsonSerializerOptions instead of exercising the real serializer path, so a silent divergence between the two option sets would regress persistence while the test stays green.

bundles.name: offline-reset-guard-test
bundles.intent: Extract the offlineEditorLoop guard in WinConditionPhase (`ReplayPlayer == null && !Lockstep.IsOnline`) that gates the destructive Edit<->Play reset away from online/replay transitions into a pure static predicate, and add a Tier-1 test. This is the highest-blast-radius decision in the reset change and is currently verified only by inspection; all its inputs are local booleans so the extraction needs no future story.

bundles.name: doc-comment-rename-cleanup
bundles.intent: Non-behavioral documentation/comment/name corrections in one sweep. Fix the EntityWorld.cs:37-38 UseItem/DropItem doc comments that say 'Handled by OrderApplier BEFORE the entity guard' when NetworkCommand correctly dispatches them AFTER the ownership guard (a latent anti-cheat trap) (DW-46). Correct the misleading precedent framing in the ResearchSystem.CompleteResearch full-world-scan comment (DW-88). Add a dated addendum to _bmad-output/fma-faction-design.md noting Story 2.8's Aviary/Air building resolved the stale 'air units unbuildable' narrative (DW-105). Rename the stale CanonicalModelHash/SimChecksum AlgoVersion test-method names (AlgoVersion_IsTwelve/_Pinned_At12 now assert 14, Stays20 asserts 21) to version-neutral forms across the ~6 test files (DW-194). Correct the stale NetworkCommand MakeReady doc and one-time re-save/normalize the 3 CRLF files, keeping raw-byte hash semantics, per the 2026-07-19 decision (DW-175).

decisions.question: The hero-centric XpPerKill (xp_per_kill) knob is superseded by UnitDefinition.XpBounty as the runtime XP source but is still validated, round-tripped, editor-exposed, and now AI-editable — how should this misleading authoring surface be resolved?
decisions.context: UnitDefinitionValidator.cs:422 validates it, HeroDefinition Clone round-trips it, UnitCardPanel.Edit.cs:777 surfaces it as a functional 'XP per kill' knob, and BalanceSuggestionApplier.cs:135 lets the AI edit it, yet no Combat/HeroXpSystem consumes it. The recorded deferral says 'repurpose' but leaves the exact semantic open.

options.label: Remove the dead knob
options.resolution: Drop XpPerKill from the validator, FactionWriter, and Unit Card editor as dead authoring surface; XpBounty remains the sole runtime XP source.

options.label: Repurpose as XP multiplier
options.intent: Wire XpPerKill into the runtime as a per-hero XP-gain multiplier applied on top of the victim's XpBounty, and update the editor help text to match.

decisions.question: ai_preset is validated data but no runtime AI system consumes it (AiOpponentSystem pilots via AiDifficulty only). Wire it into the AI, or retire the 'each side run by its ai_preset' framing?
decisions.context: Grep of AiOpponentSystem.cs finds no ai_preset reference; the field is a closed set with the single value 'balanced'. Wiring it would require expanding the preset set AND first making AiOpponentSystem deterministic (float->Fixed) for any lockstep use, which is itself gated on Epic 9.

options.label: Wire ai_preset into AI scoring
options.intent: Expand the preset set and have AiOpponentSystem select behavior weights by ai_preset, gated behind the AI float->Fixed determinism work.

options.label: Retire the framing
options.resolution: Keep ai_preset as inert metadata (or remove it) and drop the 'each side run by its preset' language from the docs.

decisions.question: The shared EditorHistory is an uncapped stack and terrain strokes duplicate full height/control Images per region, so undo memory grows unbounded. Adopt a bounded/coalescing history policy?

decisions.question: The SimChecksum-folded elevation grid is built via Godot float get_height -> Fixed.FromFloat, a cross-platform determinism risk. Build a deterministic path now or continue deferring?
